newsitem.title: CANADA: Richardson stops contributing bond pricing informa.
newsitem.headline: Richardson stops contributing bond pricing informa.

text.p: Richardson Greenshields on Thursday stopped contributing bond pricing information to some electronic data vendors in Canada amid rumors the brokerage will soon be acquired.

Industry sources said earlier that the brokerage will soon be acquired by Royal Bank of Canada's RBC Dominion Securities Inc. The takeover of its main rival would help RBC Dominion reclaim its crown as Canada's largest brokerage.
Data vendors were told Richardson Greenshields had stopped offering bond quotes because the operation of the bond desk had been temporarily suspended.
